data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis F5): Time-injection seam for out_of_window branch test determinism. probe() accepts an optional `now: datetime | None = None` parameter; defaults to `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`. Tests inject a fixed `now` (no freezegun / no datetime.now monkey-patching — stdlib only, deterministic). This matches existing reconciler patterns (concurrency.snapshot_head).
